| A55 CPU hotplug (offline + online a secondary) | A | ✗ BROKEN (model) · HARNESS (operator-run) | ✗ **under the vendor EL3 firmware chain (el3-firmware=on) - uniform across cpu1-cpu5:** CPU_OFF completes ('psci: CPUn killed'), but the core never comes back: the later online fails with 'CPUn: failed to come online'. BL31 asks the SM over SCMI for the GPC SUSPEND sleep mode, and on silicon the GPC then powers the core down at its WFI, and the SM's CPU_START powers it back up and resets it at its RVBAR. The GPC CMC A55 low-power state machine is not modelled, so the core stays powered in BL31's power-down WFI and the SM's CPU_START finds it running and does nothing. PSCI CPU_SUSPEND wake-up has the same gap, so keep cpuidle.off=1. The earlier failure recorded here (AFFINITY_INFO -110, CPU_ON -22, the core halted in BL31's 'wfi; b .' loop) was BL31's panic handler after an UNDEF at EL3 on the A55 IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED register CPUPWRCTLR_EL1, which the CPU model now provides (see Known broken, `tests/hotplug/README.md`); otherwise: all five secondaries go offline and come back, 12/12, on QEMU's own PSCI (EL3=off): 'psci: CPUn killed (polled 0 ms)', and userspace still sees 6 CPUs afterwards. ## Absent IP — N/A (NOT a negative result)

| IP block | Tier | Why absent |
|----------|:----:|-----------|
| FEC / ENET (dwmac) | N/A | i.MX 95 networking is ENETC (NETC), not the FEC/EQOS pair of i.MX 91/93 |
| EQOS (DWMAC) | N/A | same — ENETC replaces it on the i.MX 95 |
| LCDIFv3 (parallel-RGB) | N/A | i.MX 95 display is the DPU (+ LVDS/DSI), not a parallel-RGB LCDIF |
| PXP 2D engine | N/A | i.MX 95 2D acceleration is the DPU blit engine, not PXP |
| Ethos-U65 NPU | N/A | the i.MX 95 NPU is the NXP Neutron, not Arm Ethos-U65 (that is the i.MX 93) |

A record here is gated both ways: the drift check rejects an incomplete record, a dangling `ref`, or a reproducer that cannot run, and `tests/gen-test-matrix.py --check-broken` **fails if one of these reproducers passes, or fails for a reason other than its own `expect` string** — so a record can outlive neither the defect nor the evidence for it.
